create_plot_decision_surfaces: create a plot of decision surfaces for ensembles of trees on the iris dataset
build_classifier_comparison: build a comparison of decision tree, random forest, extra-trees, and AdaBoost classifiers on feature subsets
test_classifier_score: test the classifier score on shuffled and standardized iris data for each feature pair
plot_contour_decision_boundary: plot filled contour decision boundaries using fine mesh grid predictions from tree classifiers
scatter_ensemble_predictions: scatter ensemble classification predictions on a coarser grid over the feature space
